title: A protocol to generate SPH-OminiCMV-Ents mESCs
protocol: Seed mESCs on a 6-well plate using LIF-supplemented medium.
Co-transfect 1 μg of SPH, 1 μg of OminiCMV-mCherry, and 0.6 μg of PBase using Lipofectamine 3000.
Replace with 2 ml of LIF-supplemented medium 12 hours after transfection.
Digest mESCs with 0.05% trypsin for 4 minutes at 37 °C.
Inactivate trypsin and centrifuge the mixture at 1000 rpm for 3 min.
Seed mESCs to new 6-well plates and treat with puromycin (final concentration 1 μg/ml) for 4~5 days.
Digest mESCs with 0.05% trypsin for 4 minutes at 37 °C.
Inactivate trypsin and centrifuge the mixture at 1000 rpm for 3 min.
Seed mESCs to new 6-well plates.
Digest mESCs with 0.05% trypsin.
Prepare cells for FACS into 96-well plates.
Remove single colonies from 96-well plates and place them in 24-well plates.
Confirm SPH-OminiCMV positive colonies by transient transfection of sgRNAs and PCR analysis using specified primers.
Seed SPH-OminiCMV mESCs on 12-well plates using LIF-supplemented medium.
Co-transfect 0.5 μg SaKKHCas9-GFP-sgRNA and 1 μg SpCas9 sgRNA precursor using Lipofectamine 3000 (Life Technologies).
Replace with 1 ml LIF-supplemented medium 12 hours after transfection.
Digest mESCs with 0.05% trypsin and prepare for FACS, then sort positive cells.
Seed GFP-positive cells into 12-well plates.
Digest mESCs with 0.05% trypsin, then seed mESCs to new 12-well plates.
Sort single cells into 96-well plates by FACS.
Remove single colonies from 96-well plates to 24-well plates.
Measure the fluorescent intensity of SPH-OminiCMV-Ents colonies by FACS.
Take fluorescence images under a confocal microscope (Olympus FV3000).
